synthesis_requests.instruction: Write a concise achievement description grounded only in the course name and institution, suitable for an Open Badge credential.

rationale: type is fixed Achievement scaffolding; the achievement name maps from the completed course name and the criteria narrative is composed from it. The description is synthesis-backed because it is narrative text, not a direct copy. The optional achievement id is omitted — the issuer_payload phase re-derives the canonical urn.
